Blackstone to Invest ₹5,000 Crore in IIFL Finance

Blackstone will invest ₹5,000 crore in IIFL Finance, acquiring a 16% stake on a fully diluted basis. This investment is part of a larger ₹6,414 crore fundraise by IIFL Finance, aimed at strengthening its capital base to expand its secured lending business. IIFL Finance founder stated that 70% of the capital raised will fund fresh lending. The deal represents a significant private equity investment in India's non-banking financial company (NBFC) sector, and IIFL Finance shares rallied 5% following the announcement.
